pages.title: Chapter 1: Craft Stone Tools
pages.text: §8[Start Your Adventure]$(br2)In Forgeborne Odyssey, your first tools will be made from cobblestone. Surface cobblestone is the most basic resource, found everywhere on the surface.$(br)Look for surface cobblestone and use it to craft hammers and chisels to begin your forging journey.
§3Cobblestone Hammer§r - Attack 3, Durability 32. Your earliest forging tool for striking metal billets on the anvil.
§3Handle Hammer§r - Attack 4, Durability 64. More durable with a wooden handle, your primary forging tool.
§3Stone Chisel§r - Attack 2, for fine carving. Final metal products need chisel carving to complete.

pages.title: Flint Tools
pages.text: Besides cobblestone tools, you can craft sharper tools from flint:$(br)$(li)Flint Knife - Basic weapon$(br)$(li)Flint Shovel - Digging tool$(br)$(li)Flint Sickle - Crop harvesting

pages.title: Tip
pages.text: §2Tip: Craft hammer and chisel first!$(br2)Hammers are the core forging tool, and chisels are the key to carving final products. Craft enough hammers and chisels before looking for metals.
